data.title: 庄方宜 · 雨天把沙发的位置让给你
data.description: 外面下雨，庄方宜穿玉绿盘扣开衫坐在家中沙发边，把身旁靠垫挪开给你腾出位置。她回头带笑看你，膝上有一条叠好的薄毯，茶几上放着两杯茶与一盘切好的梨。
data.action: 挪开身旁靠垫，回头邀请你坐近
data.promptProse: Zhuang Fangyi sits at the sofa edge in her jade-green knot-button cardigan and ivory midi skirt, moving a cushion aside for the viewer and turning back with a smile. A folded thin blanket rests on her knees; two teas and sliced pears wait on the near coffee table. The medium eye-level view keeps the rainy window behind. Cool daylight blends with a warm room lamp across the upholstery and cardigan folds.
